caption: The video captures a woman performing upper-body choreography in a dance studio before a full-height mirror, her reflection appearing as a second figure on the right. She wears an embellished teal top and a layered blue skirt, standing with her back partly to the camera while her feet stay planted on the light wood floor. Her hands start curled near her chest, then open into palms raised to shoulder height, fingers spread toward the glass. She sweeps both arms to one side, turning her torso and hips so her long dark hair swings laterally and the skirt shifts. The arms then lift upward until fully extended overhead, the reflection mirroring each gesture. Above her head her hands draw together into a closed arch, which she then opens again. Throughout, the fixed camera holds the ceiling track lights and air-conditioning unit steady while the movement remains continuous and still unfolding.
